Nice game but devs dont give a shit about their players.

- Matchmaking breaks, with no indication. You need to restart your game just to be sure.

- Uninstalled and re-installed.

- Addiction is rough.

Update:

It's got slightly better. SIKE. THE HACKERS ARE GETTING WORSE.

SBMM makes matchmaking take forever even in populated regions. I really don't think it should take 2 minutes to find one game.

Horrendous operator balance has allowed for awful explosives/smoke/radar spam.

Map design is horrible and there's only 5 of them.

Oh, and the server performance makes the time-to-die feel almost as bad as 2010 era peer-to-peer COD games. I cannot believe it's 2024 and things like reasonable server performance are still not a priority.

1/23/2025 update:

The new shield hero is one of the worst designed specialists I've ever seen. You can't beat it with grenades because it takes reduced damage from explosives. You can't beat it by running away because it's got a grapple hook.

The new maps both are awful mazes.

Framerates have dropped significantly and stuttering was introduced.
It's not fun at all. Older players have a big advantage, and it doesn't run well on an HDD, unlike Arena Breakout.
